source_title: Meet the New Officers and Killers in ‘Dexter: Resurrection’ Season 2 - People.com
source_excerpt:
Brian Cox, Dan Stevens and Nona Parker Johnson are among the cast members joining season 2 of ‘Dexter: Resurrection’
Dexter: Resurrection season 2 premieres on Oct. 30 on Paramount+ for those with the premium plan
Brian Cox, Dan Stevens, Nona Parker Johnson and Bokeem Woodbine are among the new cast members
Cox plays The New York Ripper, while Stevens will portray The Five Borough Killer
There are several new creepy killers in Dexter: Resurrection season 2 .
The Paramount+ crime drama premiered in July 2025, following 10-episode limited series Dexter: New Blood , which continued Dexter Morgan’s ( Michael C. Hall ) story years after the original series finale in 2013. Hall and James Remar are among those who reprised their roles in Dexter: Resurrection . Now, with season 2 premiering on Oct. 30 and picking up three years after season 1, several more characters have joined the drama.
Dexter comes across several new serial killers, including The New York Ripper, played by Brian Cox , and The Five Borough Killer, portrayed by Dan Stevens , both of whom are somewhat of a threat to the titular character amid his personal turmoil.
“In his own weird midlife crisis way, one of the things that Dexter has always wanted is recognition,” showrunner Clyde Phillips told Entertainment Weekly in September 2026. “As independent as he likes to think he is, he wants that recognition, and by the time [The] Five Borough Killer has killed one person, he already has the city in his grip. And that drives Dexter f---ing crazy, because nobody knows who he is.”
In addition to several fresh faces, Lt. Joey Quinn ( Desmond Harrington ) from the original series is also back.
Below, here’s everything to know about the new characters in Dexter: Resurrection season 2.
Brian Cox as Don Framt a.k.a. The New York Ripper
Cox portrays Don Framt, a menacing serial killer better known as The New York Ripper. With a murderous trail that goes back decades, he is no longer killing but continues to torment his survivors.
“We meet him and he’s in a wheelchair, but he still terrorizes the survivors of the people he killed in phone calls,” Phillips told Entertainment Weekly in 2026. “With a voice modulator, he’ll say, ‘Today would’ve been Rachel’s 40th birthday, you must miss her.’ ”
The Emmy -winning actor is widely known for portraying Roy family patriarch Logan Roy on Succession . His film credits include Braveheart (1995), Adaptation. (2002), X2: X-Men United (2003) and Troy (2004).
“[Who] would not want to work with Brian Cox? He is the master of the masterclass. Always prepared, always powerful,” Phillips told Entertainment Weekly .
Dan Stevens as Lucas Stark a.k.a. The Five Borough Killer
Stevens portrays Lucas Stark, better known as The Five Borough Killer, another serial killer who terrorizes New York by making phone calls to the police threatening the murder of innocent citizens.
The actor spoke with Collider in August 2026 about the serial killer’s demeanor and motivations, calling him a “very unsettling character.”
“It’s very unusual in terms of the way that he operates with the sort of twisted narrative that he’s created for himself,” he said.
Before joining the Dexter: Resurrection cast, Stevens voiced the Beast in the 2017 live-action remake of Beauty and the Beast . He is also known for his roles in The Guest (2014) and the British drama Downton Abbey , among other projects.
Nona Parker Johnson portrays Fiona Mixon, a training officer in the Homicide Unit, who is also the daughter of Capt. Mixon ( Bokeem Woodbine ) and a new love interest for Harrison Morgan ( Jack Alcott ).
The actress previously played Detective Carmen “Nova” Riley on NBC’s Law & Order: Organized Crime and has made appearances on AMC’s Fear the Walking Dead , Paramount+’s Mayor of Kingstown and Apple TV’s Sugar .
Woodbine portrays the no-nonsense Capt. Mixon, who is also Fiona’s father.
The actor is known for his Emmy-nominated performance as mob enforcer Mike Milligan in Fargo season 2. He also played Shocker in Spider-Man: Homecoming (2017) and Cortland Gunn in Primetime (2026), among other roles.
Gabriel Luna as Ray Ballard a.k.a. The Sleepy-Eyed Stranger
Gabriel Luna joins the cast as Ray Ballard, a serial killer known as the Sleepy-Eyed Stranger.
The Sleepy-Eyed Stranger repeatedly breaks into people’s homes and moves things around to creep them out “just enough to haunt them — until he finally does the deed that’s made him infamous,” Phillips told Entertainment Weekly in September 2026.
Luna’s previously played Robbie Reyes, a.k.a. Ghost Rider, in the Marvel show Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. in 2016 and 2017. He also plays Tommy Miller in HBO’s The Last of Us and recently made his debut as Freddy Strain in season 2 of Prime Video’s The Terminal List .
Harrington reprises his role as Lt. Joey Quinn, who will be familiar to Dexter fans after appearing in over 70 episodes of the original series as the brash, morally questionable homicide detective.
Quinn had brief appearances while still working for Miami Metro via phone call in Dexter: Resurrection season 1, but was promoted to series regular for season 2.
The actor is also known for portraying Jack Bass on The CW’s Gossip Girl , serial killer Michael Rowan on CBS’ Elementary and FBI Director Louis Freeh on Spectrum’s Manhunt .
